name: @red-cup-engineering/derive-set-of-founder-utterances-service
description: Derives a FounderUtteranceSet from one or more Claude session transcripts already split into lines: every user-authored prompt — never a tool result, a stripped system-reminder/ide_selection span, or a house noise block — deduplicated on the first 200 characters of its text across the whole request, restricted to a closed [since, until] timestamp window, and sorted ascending by timestamp.
